style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the lead picture (phases 1 to 3, where the two fraction slots and the keypad are used) is a chocolate bar, so milk-chocolate keys with the berry Enter

images.why: Description 'Cut a whole into equal parts, colour some of them'; Stage 'a long bar 720 by 150' cut by the cutter dial (2 to 20) and by the free cut; a strip the child cuts into equal parts, no material named, so a piece of milk chocolate (IMAGES.md section 3)
images.prompt: One square slab of milk chocolate seen from directly above, smooth flat top with a soft glossy sheen and a gently bevelled edge, warm milk-chocolate brown, no markings or squares on it.

images.why: Stage 'a circle of radius 132' and phase 4 'one whole circle lies already cut in half ... cut again'; a circle cut into equal sectors is a round cake (IMAGES.md section 3), drawn as a disc and clipped per wedge (PATTERNS 17)
images.prompt: A round golden sponge cake with a clear, darker golden-brown baked crust ring all around its edge and a soft, lighter golden sponge top, lit gently from above.

images.why: Student controls 'Collection view: swaps the cut whole for a row of separate things of one kind'; separate counters of one kind are beads (IMAGES.md section 3)
images.prompt: One single round polished wooden bead in a pale honey colour, a smooth glossy ball seen from above, with a small round hole through its middle.
